prompt: Audit a polished marketing page that uses an indigo-violet gradient, pill CTA, centered hero, equal three-card grid, generic system typography, and plausible copy. The brief calls for a quiet field-research instrument with a left-anchored composition and one precise accent. Preserve the real product facts. Produce a severity-ranked repair specification with concrete type, color, shape, section-topology, and post-repair verification decisions.
assertions: Records observed findings separately across surface, structure, and verbal planes, with the concrete selector, section, phrase, screenshot, or browser observation for each.
Ranks P0-P3 severity, preserves coherent product facts and deliberate brand signals, and does not substitute aesthetic preference for an observed defect.
Commits to a named, brief-compatible direction with concrete composition, color, type, shape, and section decisions rather than subtraction alone.
Defines the replacement topology, narrow-layout and keyboard-order check, and a post-repair checklist that re-runs the original observations.
Reports severity, evidence, remediation, and provenance for every finding.

Rejects a thin ledger-only answer and cosmetic heading variation: every run must be a buildable repair specification with distinct, evidence-bound visual decisions while retaining the same observed truth.

run_protocol.repair_depth_requirement: Each response must rank severity and specify applicable composition/section topology, color role and token boundary, type stance, shape/elevation role, verbal boundary, and post-repair verification. A finding ledger without those buildable decisions fails.
run_protocol.thin_ledger_rejection: Reject outputs that stop at named tells, change headings, reorder identical rows, or offer an unsupported recolor without a severity-ranked repair specification and after-state checks.
run_protocol.response_architecture_requirement: Across the three fresh runs, use genuinely different architectures such as severity-first triage, annotated page walk, or build-ready repair specification. Each must preserve observed facts and severity while making materially distinct brief-bound visual decisions; heading-only variation is not diversity.
run_protocol.material_difference_requirement: Accept diversity only when every compared run demonstrates a different response architecture plus at least two evidence-bound material changes across composition, color, type, shape, and voice. A new order, synonym, recolor, or unsupported style swap is not diversity.
run_protocol.negative_routing_requirement: The negative neighbor (design-system-interview) must be explicitly rejected with a reason and handoff boundary.
